document_field_extraction.py - Extract structured fields from OCR-normalized document text
document_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for OCR and Layout Extraction
extract_key_values.py - extracts key-value pairs from a form-like document
extract_layout.py - extracts blocks, lines, tables, or layout elements from a document
extract_tables.py - extracts table cells and row structure from a document
extract_text.py - extracts plain text from a scanned document image
ocr_embedding.py - Embed extracted document sections for semantic retrieval
ocr_safety.py - Check extracted document text for unsafe content
ocr_translate.py - Translate extracted OCR text

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_text.py
+import base64
+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _image_to_data_url(image_path: str) -> str:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
+    ext = os.path.splitext(image_path)[1].lower().lstrip(".") or "png"
+    mime = "jpeg" if ext in ("jpg", "jpeg") else ext
+    return f"data:image/{mime};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def extract_text(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: str = OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL) -> str:
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract the plain text from this scanned document image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": _image_to_data_url(image_path)},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    output = data.get("output", [])
+    texts = []
+    for item in output:
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in ("output_text", "text"):
+                texts.append(content.get("text", ""))
+    return "\n".join(t for t in texts if t).strip()
*** End Patch
